Property.name: TuxedoService
Property.Description: Mode of communication to Tuxedo Service

Property.name: DrcUser
Property.Description: User to get the report date from CDR drc tables

Property.name: MaxRetryCount
Property.Description: how many times have we retried?

Property.name: InitStorage
Property.Description: Max Storage (in KiloBytes). Max that can allowcated to a process is 2147483647 KB. If you change this value, You meed to recycle the components.

Property.name: MinStorage
Property.Description: Min Storage (in KiloBytes). If the storage level reached less than 100KB, the process will run out of storage.

Property.name: WarnStorage
Property.Description: Warn Storage (in KiloBytes). The available storage is less. Very soon you may reach MINIMUM storage. If you change the value to -1, it will stop sending the warning alerts.
